words: Find the fake rides and fake orders our bikers and customers make. We have a few confirmed cases, nothing else is labelled, and the team can review about 2% of the rides each day.

answers.prediction_moment: After delivery, in a daily audit of the day's rides; no label is known when a ride is scored.
answers.labels: A sample of the cases we found
answers.budget: About 2% of the rides each day
answers.action: The audit team reviews the flagged rides; a missed fraud costs money
answers.data_plan: The rides, the accounts table and the file of confirmed cases

note: A problem of several parts: fake delivery marks, fake orders in rings of linked accounts, partial confirmed cases and a review budget. The accounts table comes after the project is built.
